description.value: Beef Broccoli is a Chinese cuisine restaurant located in the Governor's Landing commercial area of Westbank (West Kelowna), serving an extensive menu of Cantonese-style dishes including house specials, noodles, fried rice, and bubble tea. The restaurant offers dine-in and takeout service, with a broad menu that includes gluten-free and vegetarian options. It sits within a commercial complex near Louie Drive, a corridor accessible to cyclists riding through the West Kelowna area.

address.value: Governor's Landing, 3041 Louie Dr Unit #503, Westbank, BC V4T3E2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Chinese restaurant at 3041 Louie Dr Unit #503, Westbank BC, with phone +1 250-707-6832; the OSM record lists unit 501 which disagrees with the website's unit 503. The menu page explicitly lists a legend of 'spicy gluten free vegetarian' markers, confirming dietary options. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site.

A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify minimum criteria before inclusion.
